title: Learn Swedish at the bus stop: Har fyran redan gått? | SvenskaVardag
text:
Is the bus late, or are you? 🚌
Follow Maja and Andreas at a Stockholm bus stop and learn how to ask about the bus and tell someone to take it easy.

📝 "Hej Maja! Har fyran redan gått?"
↳ Hi Maja! Has the 4 already gone?

📝 "Nej, den är sen. Precis som du!"
↳ No, it's late. Just like you!

📝 "Okej, okej. Men jag hann!"
↳ Okay, okay. But I made it!

📝 "Där kommer den. Ta det lugnt!"
↳ There it comes. Take it easy!

🎓 You learn:
• fyran = bus line 4 (Swedes name lines by number + -an)
• sen = late
• hinna / hann = to make it in time
• Ta det lugnt! = Take it easy!
